fields.sub: Boring legal documents written without a legal team. If anything is unclear, open an issue.
fields.title: The fine print, in plain text.

sections.body: Squilla is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0. You can use, modify, and distribute it. If you distribute a modified version, you must release the source under the same license. The full text is in the LICENSE file at the root of the repository. The summary above is not a substitute.
sections.heading: License — GPL-3.0

sections.body: Free as in freedom, and free as in price. There is no commercial license tier, no SaaS escape hatch, no enterprise add-on. The repository is the product.
sections.heading: What "free" means here

sections.body: Contributors do not sign a Contributor License Agreement. You retain copyright in your contributions; you license them under GPL-3.0 by submitting a PR.
sections.heading: No CLA

sections.body: The Squilla CMS itself collects nothing. No telemetry. No phone-home. No anonymous metrics. The binary doesn't make outbound network calls unless you configure an extension that does.
sections.heading: What we collect

sections.body: This marketing site uses no cookies, no analytics, no third-party trackers. Server logs (IP, user-agent, path, timestamp) are kept for 14 days for abuse detection, then deleted.
sections.heading: This website

sections.body: Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts. If that bothers you, build the site locally — the source is in the repo.
sections.heading: Third parties

sections.body: You can read it. You can link to it. You can scrape it (the robots.txt is permissive). You cannot pretend you wrote it.
sections.heading: Use of this site

sections.body: Squilla is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind. See the GPL-3.0 license for the legally-binding version of that sentence.
sections.heading: No warranty

sections.body: "Squilla" and the compound-eye mark are unregistered trademarks of the Squilla project. Use them to refer to the project. Don't use them to brand a fork.
sections.heading: Trademarks

sections.body: Email security@squilla.dev with reproduction steps. PGP key is on the keyserver. We respond within 72 hours.
sections.heading: Reporting a vulnerability

sections.body: Standard 90 days from acknowledgement. We can negotiate longer for severe issues; we won't sit on something past 90 days for marketing reasons.
sections.heading: Disclosure timeline

sections.body: None. We're a small project on a zero-revenue license. We will publicly thank you and add you to the acknowledgements page.
sections.heading: Bug bounty

sections.body: The compound-eye dot cluster represents Squilla's segmented architecture and multi-spectrum perception. Don't recolor it; the iridescent palette is part of the identity.
sections.heading: The mark

sections.body: Set in JetBrains Mono Medium. Lowercase always. The trailing slash is part of it; please don't drop it.
sections.heading: The wordmark

sections.body: Use the kit in articles, talks, screenshots, blog posts. Link back if you can.
sections.heading: Do

sections.body: Don't combine the mark with another logo. Don't suggest we endorse your product. Don't ship a fork called "Squilla X".
